summary: SylvanAI marketing surge — streaming truncation + autoscaler fallback loop causing 5xx spike and duplicate completions (post-incident follow-up)
description: Issue summary: During a large marketing-driven traffic spike for customer SylvanAI on 2026-02-11, we observed a multi-region surge of streaming connection resets and a rapid increase in 5xx errors. The root user-visible symptoms were truncated streaming completions, duplicated final completions for some requests, and a short-term billing spike reported by the customer. Impact: Customer-facing production latency and correctness were affected for ~47 minutes, causing several customer integrations to drop messages and one downstream webhook to replay leading to duplicate completions. Environment: Hosted Redwood API (prod-us-west primary), SylvanAI enterprise account, model pinned to redwood-22B-q4k. Initial alert received 2026-02-11T08:12Z via SLO paging; customer escalated to #support-sylvanai and we opened this ticket.
impact: Approximately 2.3% global 5xx rate increase for SylvanAI traffic during the incident window; streaming sessions dropped or returned truncated output; one billing anomaly (duplicate completions) reported and later confirmed by telemetry; customer revenue-facing feature degraded for 47 minutes.
timeline: 2026-02-11T08:08Z - Marketing campaign begins; 2026-02-11T08:12Z - SLO alert for elevated 5xxs and streaming disconnects; 2026-02-11T08:15Z - Initial triage: spikes concentrated on redwood-22B-q4k serving nodes in us-west; 2026-02-11T08:23Z - Autoscaler triggered rapid pod churn on dedicated GPU pool due to mis-evaluated memory pressure; 2026-02-11T08:27Z - Fallback routing to quantized variant began; 2026-02-11T08:30Z - Observed retry loop where requests replayed to fallback variant causing doubled completions for ~600 requests; 2026-02-11T08:55Z - Hotfix deployed to throttle autoscaler burst and disable immediate fallback-on-oom behavior; 2026-02-11T09:00Z - Metrics and streaming stability returned to baseline; 2026-02-11T09:25Z - Customer accepted workaround and we started billing clean-up checks.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Replay SylvanAI production traffic profile used 2026-02-11 (attached sample RPS trace) against redwood-22B-q4k with autoscaler configured using aggressive memory-based thresholds; 2) Force high prefix cache warmup by sending long-context prompts; 3) Observe autoscaler scale-down/scale-up thrash and fallback routing kicking in; 4) Verify streaming connections see resets and some completion IDs repeat under rapid fallback conditions.
logs: See attached snippets in related_confluence_pages link. Key excerpts: 1) serving-runtime logs: 'kvcache_alloc_fail -> triggering fallback' repeated across nodes; 2) autoscaler: 'scaleDownCandidate: node-45 selected due to predicted mem < 0.12' followed by 'oom-kill' on next line; 3) gateway: 'stream-reset: ECONNRESET' and 'duplicate-completion-id detected' entries.
investigation_notes: Hypothesis 1: aggressive memory threshold in the autoscaler caused premature scale decisions during transient prefix KV cache pressure. Hypothesis 2: fallback policy with immediate routing to quantized variant lacked de-duplication/checkpointing causing request replay to result in duplicate completions. Evidence: heap and GPU memory traces show transient peaks coincident with campaign traffic bursts; autoscaler logs show rapid scale events within 90s windows; request tracing shows original request attempt followed by a immediate retry routed to fallback variant (no dedupe header present). We reproduced a similar behavior in staging by simulating long-history prompts and aggressive autoscaler thresholds. Engineering confirmed a missing dedupe-token propagation in the fallback proxy path (PR #1289 rolled back as emergency fix).
customer_communication: 2026-02-11 08:20Z - Acknowledged via #support-sylvanai that we're investigating and provided temporary mitigation steps (reduce concurrency, pin to a single model variant). 2026-02-11 09:05Z - Notified customer of hotfix and expected timeline to normalcy. 2026-02-11 12:00Z - Follow-up email with technical summary and offer to run bill reconciliation. Customer requested postmortem and billing cleanup; we provided Confluence link and opened this ticket for tracking.
resolution_notes: Short-term fix: throttled autoscaler burst rate (change autoscaler min-stable-interval from 30s to 180s) and disabled immediate fallback-on-kvcache-failure; added dedupe-token propagation in fallback proxy as emergency rollback (PR #1289 reverted). Long-term fixes deployed as part of a follow-up release: 1) Autoscaler policy update to use moving-window memory predictions and avoid oscillation; 2) Ensure fallback routing attaches dedupe headers and idempotency keys; 3) Add streaming-level watchdog to prevent connection resets from triggering immediate retries. Billing: Finance team identified ~600 duplicated completions and issued credit of equivalent token/billing value to SylvanAI account; customer accepted the credit on 2026-02-24.
postmortem_action_items: - [ENG] Autoscaler: implement moving-window smoothing and safety cooldown (owner: Priya Nandakumar) - target 2026-03-10; - [ENG] Fallback proxy: permanent dedupe-token propagation & add idempotency validation (owner: Mateo Ruiz) - target 2026-03-05; - [SRE] Add streaming watchdog to detect resets + suppress immediate client-side retries (owner: Emma Johansson) - target 2026-03-01; - [CS] Confirm billing reconciliation and customer acceptance (owner: Sophie Alvarez) - target 2026-02-26; - [DOCS] Update runbook for campaign-scale guidance for enterprise customers (owner: Ricardo Silva) - target 2026-03-15.
